what: The world list a series' zone is chosen from: how each listed zone is named, how a search folds and matches, the offsets and the order of the list, and where a stored or a device zone stands in it — the answers cal_core::zone_list must give.
why: The list, its names and its search are rules, and each surface would otherwise write its own: a city split one way on the desktop and another on the phone, an umlaut folded here and not there, Dublin sorted beside London on one device and beside Paris on the other. One list in the core answers both, and a frontend that is not JavaScript.
decidedBy: DESIGN-series-time-zone.md, section "Die Zonenliste", and Toni's decisions 17b (the full list, generated from chrono-tz), 25b (merged places found by search as "Berlin (auch Oslo)"), 26a (one rule for zones), 29a (order by standard time as of today: the smallest offset in the year from today), 30a (a fixed order: standard offset, then city), 31a ("+5" means UTC+05:00 only), 32a (built on tzdata 2025b) and the decision of 2026-11-21 that replaces 32a's release: the tzdata jiff-tzdb bundles (2026f), in which EST5EDT, CST6CDT, MST7MDT and PST8PDT are zones of their own and never listed.  The groups follow 118a (the list as groups of zones with the same rules from today on) and the stage 11 decisions 119b (an entry says its clock first), 120a (a group keeps the series' own zone), 121a (a query of offsets alone finds groups) and 122b (the count line), with the provisional ones 123a to 129a in DESIGN-series-time-zone.md.
writtenBy: By hand, from tzdata 2025b as chrono-tz 0.10.4 shipped it: the zone files for offsets, `backward` and `etcetera` for the links and their kinds. Chosen, not measured: the rules are new. Checked again against tzdata 2026f (jiff-tzdb 1.0.0 and the pinned `backward` and `etcetera`) when the zones moved there: every offset, standard offset and order row holds in both. 2026f disagrees with 2025b for Casablanca and El_Aaiun from 2026-09-20, for Vancouver, Edmonton, Inuvik and Winnipeg from 2026-11-01, for Havana from 2026-11-01 to 2027-03-14 and for Chisinau's transition times. No `at` instant falls after those dates. A standard offset reads the year after `today`, which does cross them, so no row pins the standard offset or the place in the order of those zones unless both releases agree (Casablanca's 0). A tzdata update then turns no row red for a reason that is not the code's. Two rows did change with 2026f, which made the four POSIX-style names zones of their own: the CST6CDT search and the EST5EDT device.

The group rows (groups, groupMains, groupOrder, groupSearch, head): by hand from tzdata 2026f, each membership, clock, main city, pick, order and group search checked on 2026-11-22 with a read-only reading of the TZif data jiff-tzdb 1.0.0 bundles, independent of cal-zone. They pin 2026f facts: a jiff-tzdb bump turns them red for data reasons, by name.
readBy: crates/cal-core/src/zone_list.rs (every row; the offsets, the order and the search rows with offsets only with the `zones` feature)
crates/cal-ffi/src/lib.rs (labels, notListed, search with offsets, choice, offsets and order, through the phone's doors; the fold rows are the core's alone, since no door hands out the fold)
src/intl/zoneList.contract.test.ts (labels, notListed, every search row, the offsets and choice, through the WebAssembly door and the shared shell, which carries the offsets since stage 11)
The group sections: crates/cal-core/src/zone_list.rs (with the `zones` feature), crates/cal-ffi/src/lib.rs and src/intl/zoneList.contract.test.ts through the groups door.

whereItLives.note: Inside cal-core, like seriesClock.json: twelve adapter repositories compile cal-core, and an include_str! reaching out of the crate would break the day it moves. A crate reads its own files.

notInThisTable: Whether a device's clock library can use a zone (the shell's Intl check, handed to the groups as `unusable`) and the words each surface writes (the offset's form "UTC−04:00", region names, a group's clock and cities, the count line): the surfaces' own, pinned in src/intl/zoneList.contract.test.ts.

shape.regions: the region names a search question carries, in German and English, as the translations name them
shape.labels: [{zone, city, area, region}]: listed zones and their parts
shape.notListed: names that must not be entries of the list
shape.fold: [{text, folded}]: the search's folding, pinned on its own
shape.search: [{query, regions, offsets?, hits? | count? | includes?, excludes?, note}]: `offsets` is {at, today} when the row needs the list's offsets (then only with the `zones` feature); `hits` is every hit, in list order; `count` the number of hits; `includes` hits that must be among them (order not pinned), `excludes` zones that must not be. A hit is {zone, via, also?}: zone is the tzdata id or "utc" for the UTC entry; via one match field per word; also {label, name?, kind?} the other name a word found it by.
shape.offsets: [{zone, at, today, seconds, sign?, hh?, mm?, standard?, note?}]: a listed zone's offset at `at` (sign, hh and mm in whole minutes, as the list writes it) and, when given, its standard offset as of `today` (seconds)
shape.order: [{at, today, head, tail, utcBefore}]: the first and last zones of the list, and the zone the UTC entry opens
shape.choice: [{stored?, device?, expect}]: expect is {stored, device?} with each {kind: utc | listed | not_listed | unreadable, zone?, name?, canonical?}
shape.groups: [{today?, stored?, device?, calendar?, unusable?, of, members?, main?, clock?, standard?, named?, more?, pick?, refusal?, excludes?, refused?, note}]: the group of the zone `of`. today defaults to 2026-11-22T12:00:00Z, calendar to "all" (or "none", or {except: [...]} for every listed zone but these), unusable to []. members is the exact set (order not pinned); main the first member; clock {kind, ...} in seconds; named in order; pick {zone, source} or null; refused {zone: calendar | device | null} for listed zones
shape.groupMains: [{today, mains}]: the main city of every group with more than one member, exactly, in list order
shape.groupOrder: [{today, device?, calendar?, until, head, tail, utcAfter, utcBefore}]: the main cities of the first and last groups, and the groups the UTC entry stands between
shape.groupSearch: [{today, query, offsets?, kind, hits? | count?, first?, note}]: a search with a groups answer. A hit is "utc", "group:<main city>" or, for kind zones, {zone, via, also?}
shape.head: [{stored?, device?, calendar?, expect}]: the rows above the list, each {kind, choice: {kind, zone?, name?, canonical?}, refusal?}
